title: Replace Dumas-Pernet inv() driver with in-place LU-reuse
description:
Close the invert/uniform algorithm-choice gap to fflas-ffpack at n >= 256. ## Background Per `dev/bench_results/2026-05-07-7e41400f-invert-solve-det.md` § 1 and § 5, gf2-core's `invert()` for full-rank matrices currently uses the Dumas-Pernet Table 2 driver (PLE + 2 trtri + 1 full n^3 GEMM + permutation). The constituent PLE and TRSM primitives are tuned (PLE alone is 0.55x of fflas pluq), but the total inv() operation does ~4x more O(n^3) work than PLE alone (2 trtri + 1 gemm), giving: - invert/uniform/n=256: 1.79x of fflas (FAIL 1.5x threshold) - invert/uniform/n=1024: 1.98x of fflas (FAIL 1.5x threshold) These two cells were marked [aspirational] in 7e41400f under user-approved Path A (2026-05-07). fflas-ffpack `invert` uses `dgetrf`/`dgetri`: it computes LU in-place and then back-solves columns of the identity in-place against U and L, reusing the LU storage instead of allocating a fresh full-n GEMM target. ## Algorithm In-place LU-reuse invert for `Fp

` (and ideally generic `FiniteField`): 1. Run PLE in place on the working matrix (already exists in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/ple.rs`). 2. Compute U^-1 in place using a triangular invert that overwrites U with its inverse (analogue of LAPACK `dtrtri`). 3. Compute L^-1 in place using the same triangular-invert strategy on L. 4. Multiply A^-1 = U^-1 * L^-1 in place using the existing column-of-identity back-solve pattern from `dgetri`, avoiding the explicit n^3 GEMM that the current driver materialises. 5. Apply the permutation to the columns of A^-1. Reference: LAPACK Users' Guide § dgetri, and Dumas-Pernet § 5.2 ("In-place inversion") for the field-aware variant. ## Success Criteria - [hard] invert/uniform/n=256 and invert/uniform/n=1024 reach <= 1.5x of fflas-ffpack on the Zen-3 host class. - [hard] Bit-exact equivalence with the existing Dumas-Pernet driver on randomized inputs (seed-controlled property tests). - [hard] No regression on invert/uniform/n=64, invert/deficient (any n), solve, or det cells from 7e41400f. - [hard] Singular and rank-deficient inputs continue to return None (the existing 4 tests added by 7e41400f must continue to pass). - [hard] No unsafe code outside `gf2-kernels-simd`. The driver may use unsafe in the kernel crate if needed; gf2-core remains `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`. ## Notes - This task is non-blocking on epic 97bf0879. It is a follow-up to 7e41400f closure (Wave-9b amendment 2026-05-07). The epic closure path proceeds without this work. - 615db3b9 SOTA plan owns the broader finite-field LA catch-up; this issue is a sibling under story `72ab6d0e` rather than nested under 615db3b9 (which has its own Phase-5 inheritance scope, distinct from driver-replacement). - The constituent PLE/TRSM primitives are already tuned (Wave 9a). This issue does NOT need to re-tune them; it only needs to replace the driver that composes them into invert().
